quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab 8-K: Rocket Lab signed a merger agreement to acquire Iridium Communications in a cash and stock transaction, expected to be completed in mid-2027 subject to Iridium stockholder and regulatory approvals. Rocket Lab says the combination creates an end-to-end space company spanning launch, spacecraft, spectrum and on-orbit communications services and is expected to eliminate third-party launch costs for constellation deployment and replenishment, supporting Iridium's next-generation constellation including direct-to-device services. Iridium delivered $871.7M revenue and a 57% OEBITDA margin in 2025, supports more than 2.55 million active subscribers and operates 66 satellites plus 14 on-orbit spares. CEO Peter Beck: 'This is a defining moment for the space industry and the start of a new era of strategic, accelerated growth for Rocket Lab and Iridium.'
